map.输入到手工资，估算税前工资与应税扣除。: Enter your take-home pay to estimate the pre-tax salary and taxable deductions.
map.税后反推税前采用试算迭代：设税前工资 X，则 X − 社保（X × 社保费率）−: Backing out pre-tax from after-tax uses trial-and-error iteration: let X be the pre-tax salary, then X − social insurance (X × insurance rate) − income tax = take-home pay; taxable income = X − social insurance − threshold (5000 CNY). Income tax is computed with the seven-bracket progressive rates (3% to 45%), and X is adjusted bracket by bracket until the equation holds.

map.猎头谈薪或外派补贴设计，按净收入目标倒算总包。: Negotiating recruiter packages or designing expatriate allowances: back out the gross package from the target net income.

map.先算税前工资 = (税后 − 起征×税率 + 速算扣除) / (1 − 税率×(: First solve pre-tax = (take-home − threshold × tax rate + quick deduction) / (1 − rate × (1 − insurance rate)) iteratively; the tool tries each bracket and converges near 9300 pre-tax.
map.进入 20% 档后速算扣除 16920，反推税前明显放大，工具按累进表逐档收敛。: Once the 20% bracket applies the quick deduction becomes 16920, so the back-solved pre-tax figure grows markedly; the tool converges bracket by bracket using the progressive table.
map.个税为超额累进且社保以税前为基数，税后与税前互为嵌套，需逐税率档迭代倒算。: Income tax is progressive and social insurance is based on the pre-tax salary, so take-home and pre-tax are nested; you have to iterate across tax brackets.
